field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable the NC-Link MQTT forwarding and observer proxy.

field.label: Listen address
field.help: Local address where clients connect to the observer proxy.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: Local TCP port where clients connect to the observer proxy.

field.label: Target broker
field.help: MQTT broker address to forward NC-Link traffic to.

field.label: Target port
field.help: MQTT broker TCP port. MQTT over TLS is forwarded but cannot be decoded by this observer.

field.label: Log file
field.help: JSON lines file where decoded NC-Link/MQTT metadata is written.
